title: RB-LDC: Redundancy-Balanced Latent Coding for Noise-Robust Diffusion Latents
abstract: arXiv:2611.13955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent diffusion models decode approximately correct latents, making decoder sensitivity to perturbations relevant to image quality. After whitening, forward diffusion corrupts every direction at the same signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), despite unequal decoder sensitivities. We study an invertible linear layer between the encoder and diffusion process that shifts each direction's log-SNR. Its linear minimum mean-square-error (LMMSE) recovery risk has an exact spectral expression for any whitened latent distribution. Under an energy budget and a floor ensuring invertibility, minimizing decoder-sensitivity-weighted LMMSE risk integrated over the diffusion schedule yields a unique optimal allocation. The layer aligns with the decoder's expected pullback metric and equalizes marginal risk reduction across directions, computed by a deterministic spectral solver. translated_title: RB-LDC：面向噪声鲁棒扩散潜变量的冗余平衡潜编码
translated_abstract: 潜扩散模型所解码的往往是近似正确的潜变量，因此解码器对扰动的敏感性与图像质量密切相关。在白化之后，尽管解码器对不同方向的敏感性并不相同，前向扩散过程却以相同的信噪比（SNR）破坏每个方向。我们研究在编码器与扩散过程之间引入一个可逆线性层，用以改变每个方向的对数信噪比。对于任意白化的潜变量分布，其线性最小均方误差（LMMSE）恢复风险具有精确的谱表达式。在能量预算以及保证可逆性的下限约束下，最小化在扩散调度上积分的解码器敏感性加权LMMSE风险，可得到唯一的最优分配方案。该线性层与解码器的期望回拉度量对齐，并使各方向上的边际风险降低相等化，整个计算由确定性谱求解器完成。在大预算情形下，该分配遵循关于敏感性的幂律，其指数……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出RB-LDC方法，通过在编码器与扩散过程之间加入可逆线性层，按解码器敏感性对各潜变量方向的对数信噪比进行冗余平衡式的最优再分配，从而提升扩散模型潜变量的噪声鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes RB-LDC, an invertible linear layer between the encoder and diffusion process that optimally reallocates per-direction log-SNR in a decoder-sensitivity-weighted, redundancy-balanced manner, yielding noise-robust diffusion latents.
